name: meeting-notes
description: Walks an agent through writing up the notes from a desk meeting.

# Meeting notes

Use this Skill when a desk meeting has ended and its notes have not been written
up yet.

1. Read the agenda and the list of people who attended.
2. Write one paragraph per agenda item, in the order the agenda gives.
3. List each decision the meeting reached, with the item it belongs to.
4. Record the notes on the desk's meeting record.

## Follow-up

Add a follow-up line for any agenda item the meeting reached no decision on, and
name the person the item was left with.
